title: 2 of my black cats gave birth on the same day
author: kervsky
text: 2 of my black cats gave birth on the same day (yesterday) I'm not sure which kitten was to what mother cat so I placed them in a big box and they're basically co rearing the 5 kittens (4 black, 1 white), I'll need to give them away but I'm partial to keeping the white kitty.
blurb: Two black cats had their litters on the same day, so their human put all five newborns (four black, one white) in one big box, and the moms are now raising them together. Here, a mama in a blue collar snuggles the whole crew.
